reason: I was burned before by Jamku and desktop ERP tools that my staff abandoned within two months, and I am deeply wary of whether connecting Google Drive exposes all my firm's private client files. For a two-person practice, I will not pay ₹12,990 upfront when there is a free pilot to first test data privacy and staff adoption.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files, and will my assistant just abandon it after two months like our past software?
would_change_my_mind: Clear technical proof during the free pilot that zero external Drive files are accessible, plus seeing my assistant actively use it daily for 60 days without complaint.
